label: preparing
what: A hospitality committee gathering in the great hall this evening, with bread supplied for it. Innkeeper explicitly identified the committee as builder, freight, and himself; the builder and freight coordinated bread deliveries, and baker supplied bread. Neighbour also knowingly helped with baking and was involved in the delivery effort, though not named as a committee member. The purpose beyond hospitality and the gathering itself is not established; claims about a bridge or port change remain unconfirmed rumor.
